title: Spending actions and value iteration on the research-corrected base bot r15
question: With the base bot's research weight corrected (greedy-full-probe-perf-r15) and the new opponents, does value iteration over the spending actions still find a policy that beats the bot it steers?
change: Experiment 23 unchanged except the base bot (greedy-full-probe-perf-r15) and the opponents (rl-gate defaults after #204: r15, probe-perf, anchor probe-perf).
method: 300k games with a random spend3 action per turn; value iteration for both state versions and min-count 1, 5, 20, 50; min-count chosen per version on 2,000 validation seeds; both chosen policies on the 10,000 evaluation seeds
setups: Perfection, 16×16 continents, 4 players, Crazy, seat 0 Xin-Xi (human seat), learner base greedy-full-probe-perf-r15; opponents greedy-full-probe-perf-r15, greedy-full-probe-perf, greedy-full-probe-perf (anchor), seats shuffled per seed (rl-gate defaults from 27 Nov)
